title: KV-Cache Decoding
signature: class CachedSelfAttention: __init__(W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, num_heads), prefill(x) -> (n, d), step(x_t) -> (d,)
hints: Keep the cached keys and values per instance, set up in __init__, with shape (num_heads, length, d_head).
Append the new tokens' K and V to the cache first, then attend. A token must see its own key.
In prefill, the new queries sit at positions P..P+n-1, where P is the cache length before the call. Query i may see key j when j <= P + i.
step(x_t) is prefill on a single row: prefill(x_t[None, :])[0].
